status: preflight; freeze only with approved final contract
format: array of unique {id, description, actions}; each case uses fresh directory
execution: each named actor is a real separate worker process containing one dictionary and touch instance; sequential commands are acknowledged on stdout, async writes remain production async; barrier operations use test-only dylib and bounded pipe waits

stop.actor: gated existing; SIGSTOP plus waitpid WUNTRACED acknowledgement

check.expected: type per field; numeric touch uses tolerance1e-9
check.word: required count/known/blocked/pair; ascii lower letter offsetX/Y

requiredChecks: every case has >=1 check and every claimed save/clear outcome must be checked
barrierRules: do not send synchronous mutating command that stops at gate and then expect its ack; arm -> background -> waitGate permits independent actions; beforeRename has transaction lock held, clear must returnfalse until released/terminated; beforeLock permits clear success before stale commit validation; failRename is a one-attempt precommit error, next save retries
capabilityLimits: no controller/UI/native iOS suspension, no raw keystrokes/ranking/language mode; spellings alone do not establish EN/ES/bilingual stacks; no sleeps/clock ordering; unavailable barriers recorded separately not passed
